create_PipelineCallback: create a custom PipelineCallback subclass implementing tensor_inputs and callback_fn for a diffusers pipeline
use_MultiPipelineCallbacks: create a MultiPipelineCallbacks instance to chain multiple PipelineCallback objects together for a pipeline
use_SDCFGCutoffCallback: create an SDCFGCutoffCallback to disable CFG after a cutoff step in a Stable Diffusion pipeline
use_SDXLCFGCutoffCallback: create an SDXLCFGCutoffCallback to disable CFG after a cutoff step in a Stable Diffusion XL pipeline
use_SD3CFGCutoffCallback: create an SD3CFGCutoffCallback to disable CFG after a cutoff step in a Stable Diffusion 3 pipeline
